stories.title: China's trade barriers biggest hurdle in bilateral ties, says Nirmala Sitharaman; flags $100 billion deficit
stories.summary: Nirmala Sitharaman has identified China's constraints on Indian exports as a crucial hindrance to trade advancement. The finance minister reported a staggering trade deficit exceeding $100 billion with China this year, even with improved diplomatic relations. She noted that non-tariff barriers obstruct Indian products, especially generic medicines, from entering China.

stories.title: Current account deficit narrows to $5.2 billion in August: RBI data

stories.title: India's trade deficit widens to $30.21 billion in September despite 23% jump in exports
stories.summary: In September, India's merchandise trade deficit expanded to $30.21 billion from $26.86 billion in August. Exports experienced a notable boost, increasing by 23.04% year-on-year with total figures at $44.4 billion. The growing trade gap signals a significant difference between imports and exports, surpassing economists' expectations of a $30.4 billion deficit. Nonetheless, these figures suggest strong ongoing momentum in India's export activities.

stories.title: Amazon launches two new portable AI listening devices
stories.summary: Frontier is a bracelet and Eclipse is a brick that resembles a portable magnetic charger. Users attach the devices to their smartphones. They aggregate information from calendars, apps like email and other points throughout the day that are accessed through an app or a website, Amazon said.

stories.title: Google boosts news and link visibility in AI mode
stories.summary: Google announced Thursday it will start displaying links to websites and articles more prominently and higher up in search results powered by artificial intelligence (AI), as brands and news publishers warn of a sharp decline in their traffic. According to a report by consultancy Chartbeat, news website publishers saw a 40 percent drop in traffic coming from Google between July 2025 and July 2026.
